name: Rocco
source:
An elven boy who has strayed from the forest. 

He is Yuri's brother in arms from when Yuri was an adventurer, and now remains a loyal follower. 

He used to be a bandit and has a variety of skills, including picking and archery.

[From [url=https://frill.product.co.jp/frill05/chara.html]official site[/url]]
